description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's ability to create a servo token.
Sacrifice Retrofitter Foundry to Krark-Clan Ironworks adding {C}{C} to your mana pool.
Activate Salvaging Station to return Retrofitter Foundry to the battlefield.
Sacrifice the Servo token to Krark-Clan Ironworks adding {C}{C} to your mana pool.
Repeat.
